harness_path_note: Harness is under ace3/rtl/candidates, rather than ace3/tb, to obey this mission's writable-path boundary.
previous_route: run_residual_exact_grid_q24_v1.py remains compile/import/elaboration-only; its first attempt is not rerun or relabeled

expectations.oracle: independent Fraction-based finite FP16 interpretation and representable-neighbor search; no RTL imports
expectations.oracle_crosscheck: Python struct binary16 decoding/encoding and exact integer sums, not oracle-generated expectations
expectations.rtl_inputs: all 63488 finite FP16 words; general binade/tie/overflow/narrowing cases; no model tensors
expectations.persistence: eight actual-output-fed increments, plus independent same-view/different-state check
expectations.four_state: real Icarus vvp, participating X/Z on each data port and unknown start/input-valid/output-ready/clear/reset controls
expectations.waveform: protocol and fault-control phase; arithmetic phase preserves exact vector rows and failure diagnostics
expectations.codec: 896 signed-int64 little-endian plus tag records; exactly 8064 bytes; explicit trusted metadata equality, not real model provenance

invariants.U01: all finite/subnormal FP16 lift and exact projection; nonfinite rejection
invariants.U02: exact state recurrence and remainder retention, primitive only
invariants.U03: all zero-sign combinations, cancellation, noncanonical tags
invariants.U04: both signs, RNE even/odd ties, binade/subnormal edge, 65504 and 65520 boundary
invariants.U05: signed extension, int64 extremes, narrowing overflow code 3 versus FP16 overflow code 4
invariants.U08: 896 paired outputs in unstalled and seeded stalled schedules; stable full tuple and elastic replacement
invariants.U09: primitive idle/start/pending-output/partial-vector/fault reset and clear cancellation; no decoder commit claim
invariants.U10: participating X/Z payload fault 1 and diagnosed no-transfer controls/invalid counts
invariants.U11: portable codec byte round-trip, exact endianness and restored residual recurrence; reject invalid metadata, length, tags and nonfinite view

score_policy: PASS only if contract elaboration, all selected Python unit tests, and nonzero Icarus semantic checks pass, exact terminal counters match, and frozen source/input bindings remain unchanged
independent_review: normal Host Reviewer required; not granted by this regression contract
